# Fix auth token expiry (revised)

## Context
Token expiry check in auth/middleware.ts uses `<` instead of `<=`, so tokens expiring exactly at the boundary pass validation.

## Changes
- Fix the comparison and extract an `isExpired()` helper.
- Split the migration into two PRs: middleware + helpers first, then the remaining call sites.
- Add boundary-case tests: expiry at, before, and after now.

## Verification
Run `npm test -- auth`; all suites green. Add the smoke login to the e2e suite instead of a manual check.
